distinguishing_features: Uses a physical metal-to-metal lip seal rather than a monitoring or control scheme.
Uses differential thermal expansion between the lip and body to alter seal contact pressure.
Intends the seal itself to prevent leakage during thermal and pressure cycling.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Maintain a leak-tight subsea hydraulic connection as pressure and temperature vary.
parsed.viable_reason: As written, the design does not establish a reliable thermal gradient or define lip geometry and interference that convert expansion into sealing force, so its calculated stress does not demonstrate adequate contact pressure at the seal.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Using a coefficient-of-expansion mismatch to adjust interference is a routine engineering approach, and the cited prior art supplies no non-obvious mechanism that would make this implementation inventive.
